runtime_encoding: lossless uint64 PC plus lossless 58-bit cache-line number

neural_action_decoder.request_count: natural-frequency unweighted two-class cross-entropy with log empirical-prior bias initialization, raw deterministic argmax, and rounded positive log-count
neural_action_decoder.targets: deterministic scalar signed-log cache-line delta with emitted-coordinate free-running feedback

captured_stride_actions_role: normal replay and supervised labels only
training_target: captured Stride request count and direct target addresses as supervision only

lstm.architecture: compact single-layer exact-PC-keyed stateful LSTM plus natural-frequency deterministic hurdle/count and scalar direct-delta decoder
lstm.pc_state_memory: dynamic exact-PC map with no fixed tracker capacity
lstm.stateful_training: chronological per-PC TBPTT; hidden/cell values cross batches and graph history is detached at batch boundaries
lstm.action_training: teacher count schedules loss-bearing ranks; each next decoder state receives the model's own predicted scalar coordinate
lstm.inference_history: fresh state followed by complete train, guard, and evaluation chronology; guard is causal warm-up/audit only and only evaluation callbacks are decoded

v17_diagnosis.failure: post-hoc prior correction retained an over-emitting positive tail across all capacities; capacity growth was not monotonic
v17_diagnosis.v18_change: train the gate with natural-frequency unweighted cross-entropy, initialize its bias from the training empirical prior, and decode raw logits by deterministic argmax

parameter_counts: measured and asserted exactly; never thresholded
